blocks.text: SAN JOSE, Calif. – Following years of student advocacy for greater recognition of Filipino Americans’ contributions to US history, San Jose State University has unveiled a permanent mural honoring Filipino heritage, labor activism and community leadership. The four-sided mural, painted by Filipino American artist and university alumna Francesca “ChiChai” Mateo, was unveiled Oct. 30 outside […]...
